review_procedure: The custodian creates two fresh sessions outside the repository and gives each only the agent_package and reviewer_instructions; no manifest, source, repo/history, connectors, crosswalk, or other output.
Review each item independently for direct answer, useful indirect clue, neutral, irrelevant/harmful, or insufficient evidence; record a query-specific textual warrant, doubt, and confidence.
Keep original outputs separately; compare only after both are frozen. Do not merge votes or call agent judgments human annotations.

After freezing both responses, a named bilingual human adjudicator selected by Dennys compares question, presented text, and original text for all 156 presentations (152 transformed, 4 unchanged; 156 rule applications, with overlap); records semantic impact before unblinding source gold roles.
Preserve both initial judgments and adjudication rationale; this process does not automatically substitute agent passes for human reviewers.
If isolation cannot be verified, label both passes exploratory/non-independent and defer gold changes/closure pending two genuinely independent human reviews or a verifiable isolated protocol.
title: Blind E1 semantic review package, v1

transformations.foils: exactly 2 items per case sampled uniformly without replacement from other nodes in the same episode, excluding that case's flagged concepts; no role-based filtering
transformations.identifiers: source episode/query/concept IDs and role names replaced by seeded opaque case/item codes; not serialized in agent package

memory_text.operation: remove matched leading numbered title, preserve following body verbatim
remove exact trailing sentence if present
replace exact phrase with 'la acción es' to remove the embedded role marker, preserving the action text

transformations.ordering: sort source cases and available foils before seeded PRNG; sample foils, shuffle items within cases, shuffle cases, then assign opaque codes from the same PRNG stream
transformations.question_text: copied verbatim from query; no query_id/type/answer/abstention field is emitted
transformations.text_policy: no translation, paraphrase, lowercasing, or content rewriting beyond the listed transformations
